246: When beautiful Carla Purty joins the university faculty, genetic professor Dr. Sherman Klump grows desperate to whittle his 400-pound frame down to size and win her heart. Sherman Klump / Buddy Love / Lance Perkins / Papa Klump / Mama Klump / Grandma Klump / Ernie Klump

No more mercy. No more shame. No more sequels - honest! - We lied.

We will not walk in fear of one another.

Trailer trash wig wearin' acid wash jean lovin' rock concert t-shirt sportin' hero.

The most dangerous thing about school used to be the students.

In the blink of an eye, the terror begins.

It takes a real man to become a maid of honor.

Why deny what you desire the most.

It only looks like the good life.

The festival hit of the year!

There's only one person left who believes Mick O'Brien can make it... Mick O'Brien.

For the sake of your sanity, pray it isn't true!

8438: A rising Hollywood actor decides to take personal revenge against a group of four persistent photographers to make them pay for almost causing a personal tragedy involving his wife and son.

Beirut, 1982: The Paris of the Middle East Was Burning

Death was not the end but the beginning
10486: In 1991, a sheltered teenager comes of age during a wild summer on Cape Cod, getting rich from selling pot to gangsters, falling in love for the first time, partying, and eventually realizing that he's in way over his head.

The hardest thing is to do something which is close to nothing.

You don't choose your own family

When you don't have a choice, you change.

13814: Charles drifts through politics, religion and psychoanalysis, rejecting them all. Once he realises the depth of his disgust with the moral and physical decline of the society he lives in, he decides that suicide is the only option...
14070: A girl reaches the age of nine and is supposed to act as a grown woman according to her family. A girl participates in a bike race against the will of her husband. An elderly woman decides she wants to buy all the things she always wanted but could never get.

See the strange case of the strangler-killer on the night express!

Leo just met the love of his life. At her wedding.

From the darkness, the ultimate fighter rises.

He knew where $50,000 lay begging to be STOLEN!

Narrator (voice) (segment 'The Fall of the House of Usher')
Narrator (voice) (segment 'The Facts in the Case of M. Valdemar')
Prince Prospero (voice) (segment 'The Masque of the Red Death')

Hard to love... Harder to kill.

Love was a gamble she couldn't afford to lose.

For Pete it's love at first sight, but Gladys has her mind on other things, making a name for herself. Through a fluke of advertising she winds up with her name plastered over 10 billboards throughout city.
19446: Julia Ross secures employment with a wealthy widow and goes to live at her house. Two days later, she awakens in a different house in different clothes and with a new identity.
She went to sleep as a secretary ... and woke up a madman's "bride"!
19958: Barry is a drug-addled, abusive bastard who - after yet another bender - is abducted by aliens. 20214: When his long-time disappeared father is entering his life again, Jean-Luc, a successful doctor, has no option but to face his own life story. Will he ever be able to forget and forgive?

And it won't be their last

The best way to resist is to survive.

He's in a coma... Yet, he can kill...
22518: When a woman’s twin sister is drowned, she assumes her identity in order to be close to the man she feels her sister took from her years before.
Their faces the same...Their fates so different!

From the Depths of the Earth, He Will Rise.
23030: Pressured by his late mother's ghost to return home to the family he abandoned, a former addict grabs a bag of pills and a sack of marijuana and hits the road to Shreveport.
23286: A hitman finds himself embroiled in the middle of a Mafia war between the Sicilians and the Calabrians.

The story revolves around the perspective of Sukumara Kurup and the Police officers who were investigating the case.
THE STORY UNFOLDS INDIA'S LONGEST WANTED FUGITIVE
24566: A driven American exec heads to Paris determined to acquire a champagne brand by Christmas — and accidentally falls for the heir to the bubbly empire.
Christmas in France is always a good idea.
24822: A kindly nurse tries to unlock the secrets of a coma patient's injuries — and discovers the bitter rivalry, infidelity, betrayal and murder behind them.
25078: In 2029, Korea's lunar probe Woori embarks on a historic journey to the moon, capturing global attention.
Only one astronaut is left stranded on the moon
25334: At a secluded summer camp, timid and introverted 12-year-old Morgan is thrust into a waking nightmare when a once-fabled campfire tale becomes real. 25590: Through both her moments of fear and bravery, a woman discovers that embracing her vulnerabilities is as vital to her inner strength as facing challenges head-on.

26870: A girl with extraordinary powers goes to a psychiatrist for a solution.  Debi: Misir Ali Prothombar or simply Debi is a 2018 Bangladeshi supernatural thriller film based on Humayun Ahmed's novel of the same name. 27126: A seasoned assassin plays both sides in a Russian gang war and becomes the target of an unknown enemy.
When killers collide, every bullet counts.

Legends are made in the cage.

However, Lulu tires of her cloistered existence, and begins hanging out in shady bars, looking for vicarious thrills and danger.
27894: Rita, an ordinary, but lonely woman is kidnapped. Her captors are the Árpáds; they claim she is not called Rita but Szilvi, a runaway from their family. Family is safety. Family is joy. Family is prison.

Wood and Vin bring Utah in on their lucrative and illegal dealings, where saving lives comes second to the bottom line.

Treasure never stays buried for long.
28918: Amazing China is a documentary film edited and produced based on the six-episode documentary series "Brilliant China" broadcasted on China Central Television (CCTV). 29174: Since Jahaan only has a few months left to live, his brother Bahman organizes a get-together with his closest friends at Jahaan's farmhouse up north to celebrate what will likely be his final birthday.
My Friends are All I Have

Now, Lucia must accept that the perfect family was not exactly what she thought.

A game of life or death.

Something Very Hungry is About to Hatch!

30454: A group of friends' fishing boat capsizes off the coast of Mexico and they're left alone stranded at sea and struggling for survival.

Change your Mind. Change your Body. Change your Life.

31222: After his father's death, Eric Zimmerman travels to Spain to oversee his company's branches. In Madrid, he falls for Judith and engage in an intense, erotic relationship full of exploration. However, Eric fears his secret may end their affair.

Sherlock Holmes meets Jack the Ripper! Here comes the original caped crusader!

32246: A child escapes from Poland during World War II and first heads to Greece before coming of age in Canada.
